actions.action: Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window
Lease an aircraft with crew for 2 weeks
Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks

decisions.message: Kestrel Air update on the FAA engine inspections: the checks are a precaution ordered for one engine type, and no Kestrel aircraft has had a problem with this part. We have leased a spare aircraft with crew to keep your flights running and added staff at the airports and on the phones. If you would rather change or cancel a trip between Nov 23 and Dec 6, you can do it at no cost in the app.
decisions.why:
The inspections take aircraft out of service in Thanksgiving week.
A leased spare protects the 98% flights goal and rebooking.
A calm, factual message answers the TikTok video and free changes cut anxiety.

actions.action: Backup ground handling contract at both bases for the strike days
Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks
Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Kestrel Air update: our ground handling contractor's workers in Orlando and Philadelphia are on a 48-hour strike on Dec 22-23. Backup ground crews are working at both bases. If your flight is canceled, we will rebook you on a partner airline when our own flights are full. If you would rather move or cancel a trip between Dec 21 and Jan 3, you can do it at no cost in the app.
decisions.why:
Backup crews cut strike cancellations at both bases.
The partner deal covers weeks 8-9, when knock-on cancellations hit.
Free changes through Jan 3 protect travelers if the strike is extended.
